title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
summary: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

title: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
summary: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.

title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
summary: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
summary: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
summary: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
summary: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
summary: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.
